Toasted Chestnut + Water = Chestnut Milk
Chest + Chestnut Milk = Chest Milk

6 - Chestnut Milk Toast: 
Treasure + Treasure = Chest
Chest + Tree = Chestnut
Chestnut + Fire = Toast
Chestnut + Toast = Toasted Chestnut
Toasted Chestnut + Water = Chestnut Milk
Chestnut Milk + Toasted Chestnut = Chestnut Milk Toast

6 - Chilean: 
Tree + X = Wood
Fire + Wood = Campfire
Campfire + Water = Soup
Fire + Soup = Chili
Chili + Map = Chile
Chile + Map = Chilean

6 - Portland: 
Wind + X = Y
Water + Y = Why
Map + Why = Where
Where + Where = Village
Village + Water = Port
Port + Why = Portland

6 - Portray: 
Wind + X = Y
Water + Y = Why
Map + Why = Where
Where + Where = Village
Village + Water = Port
Port + Y = Portray
